```{r}
# 本脚本用于比较“临床诊断抑郁 vs 非抑郁”两组
# 在四个抑郁量表（DSRSC、PHQ-9、CDI、DASS）上的得分分布
# 分别比较了数据协调前以及协调后的
# 数据来源：
# Questionnaire_With_Diagnosis_Label.xlsx
# （已完成：ID 去重 + 病历诊断标签匹配）
#
# 分析流程与检出率分析保持一致：
# - 数值转换
# - 原始数据 -1
# - 反向计分
# - 年龄限制（7–18 岁）

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(mirt)
library(papaja)
library(patchwork)
library(openxlsx)
library(here)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) 读取数据
# ------------------------------------------------------------
diag_raw <- read.xlsx(
  here("DATA", "Questionnaire_With_Diagnosis_Label.xlsx")
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2) 基础处理与描述统计
# ------------------------------------------------------------
diag_raw <- diag_raw %>%
  mutate(
    Gender = factor(Gender, levels = c("男", "女"), labels = c(1, 2))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(matches("Gender|Age|DSRSC|PHQ|DASS|CDI"), as.numeric)
  ) %>%
  filter(Age >= 7 & Age <= 18)

cat("用于分析的样本量：", nrow(diag_raw), "\n")

cat("\nDepression_status 分布：\n")
print(table(diag_raw$Depression_status))

cat("\n性别人数统计：\n")
print(table(diag_raw$Gender))

diag_gender_summary <- diag_raw %>%
  summarise(
    Male = sum(Gender == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    Female = sum(Gender == 2, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total = n(),
    Male_percent = round(Male / Total * 100, 2),
    Female_percent = round(Female / Total * 100, 2)
  )

cat("\n性别比例：\n")
print(diag_gender_summary)

diag_age_summary <- diag_raw %>%
  summarise(
    Age_mean = round(mean(Age, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Age_sd   = round(sd(Age, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Age_min  = round(min(Age, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Age_max  = round(max(Age, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
  )

cat("\n年龄统计：\n")
print(diag_age_summary)

dir.create(here("FIGURE"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(here("OUTPUT"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

openxlsx::write.xlsx(
  list(
    gender_summary = diag_gender_summary,
    age_summary = diag_age_summary
  ),
  here("OUTPUT", "Diagnosis_Distribution_Descriptive_Stats.xlsx"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

cat("✔ 已导出：OUTPUT/Diagnosis_Distribution_Descriptive_Stats.xlsx\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3) 预处理（与检出率分析保持一致）
# ------------------------------------------------------------
diag_raw <- diag_raw %>%
  mutate(
    across(matches("DSRSC|PHQ|DASS|CDI"), ~ .x - 1)
  )

CDI_reverse_items <- c(
  "CDI2", "CDI5", "CDI7", "CDI8", "CDI10",
  "CDI11", "CDI13", "CDI15", "CDI16",
  "CDI18", "CDI21", "CDI24", "CDI25"
)

DSRSC_reverse_items <- c(
  "DSRSC3", "DSRSC5", "DSRSC6", "DSRSC10",
  "DSRSC14", "DSRSC15", "DSRSC17", "DSRSC18"
)

diag_raw <- diag_raw %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(CDI_reverse_items), ~ 2 - .)) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(DSRSC_reverse_items), ~ 2 - .))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4) 建立用于 raw + harmonization 的统一分析样本
#    —— 去掉量表题目缺失，保证 raw / theta 使用同一批样本
# ------------------------------------------------------------
diag_item_vars <- c(
  paste0("DSRSC", 1:18),
  paste0("PHQ", 1:9),
  c("DASS3", "DASS5", "DASS10", "DASS13", "DASS16", "DASS17", "DASS21"),
  paste0("CDI", 1:27)
)

diag_analysis <- diag_raw %>%
  select(ID, Gender, Age, Depression_status, all_of(diag_item_vars)) %>%
  drop_na()

cat("\n用于 raw + harmonization 的完整作答样本量：", nrow(diag_analysis), "\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5) 协调前：原始总分
#    —— CDI26 不计入总分
# ------------------------------------------------------------
diag_analysis <- diag_analysis %>%
  mutate(
    raw_DSRSC = rowSums(select(., starts_with("DSRSC")), na.rm = TRUE),
    raw_PHQ   = rowSums(select(., starts_with("PHQ")), na.rm = TRUE),
    raw_CDI   = rowSums(select(., starts_with("CDI")), na.rm = TRUE) - CDI26,
    raw_DASS  = rowSums(select(., starts_with("DASS")), na.rm = TRUE)
  )

diag_raw_long <- diag_analysis %>%
  select(
    ID,
    Depression_status,
    raw_DSRSC,
    raw_PHQ,
    raw_CDI,
    raw_DASS
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("raw_"),
    names_to = "Measure",
    values_to = "Score"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Measure = recode(
      Measure,
      raw_DSRSC = "DSRSC",
      raw_PHQ   = "PHQ-9",
      raw_CDI   = "CDI",
      raw_DASS  = "DASS"
    ),
    Depression_status = factor(
      Depression_status,
      levels = c("Non-depression", "Depression")
    )
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5.1) 原始 cutoff
# ------------------------------------------------------------
cutoff_raw_DSRSC <- 15
cutoff_raw_PHQ   <- 10
cutoff_raw_CDI   <- 20
cutoff_raw_DASS_male   <- 4
cutoff_raw_DASS_female <- 5

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6) 协调前分布图函数
#    —— raw cutoff 线
# ------------------------------------------------------------
plot_diag_raw_distribution <- function(data, measure_name, show_legend = FALSE) {

  dat <- data %>% filter(Measure == measure_name)
  n <- nrow(dat)

  p <- ggplot(
    dat,
    aes(x = Score, fill = Depression_status, color = Depression_status)
  ) +
    geom_histogram(
      binwidth = 1,
      position = position_dodge(width = 1),
      alpha = 0.65,
      linewidth = 0.2
    ) +
    geom_density(
      aes(y = after_stat(density * n * 1)),
      linewidth = 1,
      alpha = 0.10,
      adjust = 1
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "Non-depression" = "#2ca25f",
        "Depression" = "#2b8cbe"
      )
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "Non-depression" = "#2ca25f",
        "Depression" = "#2b8cbe"
      )
    ) +
    labs(
      title = measure_name,
      x = "Depression sum score",
      y = "Frequency"
    ) +
    papaja::theme_apa(base_size = 18) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.position = if (show_legend) c(0.98, 0.98) else "none",
      legend.justification = c(1, 1),
      legend.direction = "vertical",
      legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3),
      legend.key = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.margin = margin(4, 6, 4, 6),
      plot.margin = margin(5.5, 12, 5.5, 5.5)
    )

  if (measure_name == "DSRSC") {
    p <- p + geom_vline(
      xintercept = cutoff_raw_DSRSC,
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.9,
      alpha = 0.8
    )
  }

  if (measure_name == "PHQ-9") {
    p <- p + geom_vline(
      xintercept = cutoff_raw_PHQ,
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.9,
      alpha = 0.8
    )
  }

  if (measure_name == "CDI") {
    p <- p + geom_vline(
      xintercept = cutoff_raw_CDI,
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.9,
      alpha = 0.8
    )
  }

  if (measure_name == "DASS") {
    p <- p +
      geom_vline(
        xintercept = cutoff_raw_DASS_male,
        linetype = "dashed",
        linewidth = 0.9,
        alpha = 0.8
      ) +
      geom_vline(
        xintercept = cutoff_raw_DASS_female,
        linetype = "dotted",
        linewidth = 0.9,
        alpha = 0.8
      )
  }

  return(p)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7) 协调前分布图
# ------------------------------------------------------------
p_diag_raw_DSRSC <- plot_diag_raw_distribution(diag_raw_long, "DSRSC", TRUE)
p_diag_raw_PHQ   <- plot_diag_raw_distribution(diag_raw_long, "PHQ-9", FALSE)
p_diag_raw_CDI   <- plot_diag_raw_distribution(diag_raw_long, "CDI", FALSE)
p_diag_raw_DASS  <- plot_diag_raw_distribution(diag_raw_long, "DASS", FALSE)

diag_raw_plot <- (
  p_diag_raw_DSRSC |
  p_diag_raw_PHQ   |
  p_diag_raw_CDI   |
  p_diag_raw_DASS
) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Raw-score distributions by clinical diagnosis",
    tag_levels = "A",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 16),
      plot.tag = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")
    )
  )

ggsave(
  filename = here("FIGURE", "Diagnosis_Distribution_Raw.png"),
  plot = diag_raw_plot,
  width = 18,
  height = 5.2,
  dpi = 300
)

cat("✔ 已生成：FIGURE/Diagnosis_Distribution_Raw.png\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8) 数据协调（Harmonization）
#    —— CDI26 不进入 IRT
# ------------------------------------------------------------
diag_harm_items <- diag_analysis %>%
  select(
    starts_with("DSRSC"),
    starts_with("PHQ"),
    starts_with("DASS"),
    starts_with("CDI")
  ) %>%
  select(-CDI26)

diag_fit_all <- mirt(
  diag_harm_items,
  1,
  itemtype = "graded",
  SE = FALSE
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8.1) build_walk_diag
#      —— 改成 item + name 联合匹配
# ------------------------------------------------------------
build_walk_diag <- function(scale_dat, fit_all_model) {

  tmp <- mirt(scale_dat, 1, itemtype = "graded")
  sv2 <- mod2values(tmp)
  uni <- mod2values(fit_all_model)

  # 用 item + name + class 联合匹配
  sv2$key <- paste(sv2$item, sv2$name, sv2$class, sep = " | ")
  uni$key <- paste(uni$item, uni$name, uni$class, sep = " | ")

  idx <- match(sv2$key, uni$key)

  if (any(is.na(idx))) {
    bad <- sv2[is.na(idx), c("item", "name", "class")]
    message("以下参数在共同模型中找不到（前30个）：")
    print(head(bad, 30))
    stop("Crosswalk 参数匹配失败。")
  }

  if (length(unique(idx)) != length(idx)) {
    stop("联合匹配后仍存在重复匹配，需进一步检查。")
  }

  sv2$value <- uni$value[idx]
  sv2$est <- FALSE

  walk <- mirt(scale_dat, 1, itemtype = "graded", pars = sv2)

  list(
    eap = fscores(walk, method = "EAP", full.scores.SE = FALSE),
    eapsum = fscores(walk, method = "EAPsum", full.scores = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9) 协调后 theta
# ------------------------------------------------------------
walk_diag_DSRSC <- build_walk_diag(
  diag_analysis %>% select(starts_with("DSRSC")),
  diag_fit_all
)

walk_diag_PHQ <- build_walk_diag(
  diag_analysis %>% select(starts_with("PHQ")),
  diag_fit_all
)

walk_diag_DASS <- build_walk_diag(
  diag_analysis %>% select(starts_with("DASS")),
  diag_fit_all
)

walk_diag_CDI <- build_walk_diag(
  diag_analysis %>% select(starts_with("CDI")) %>% select(-CDI26),
  diag_fit_all
)

diag_theta <- tibble(
  ID = diag_analysis$ID,
  Depression_status = diag_analysis$Depression_status,
  theta_DSRSC = as.numeric(walk_diag_DSRSC$eap[, 1]),
  theta_PHQ   = as.numeric(walk_diag_PHQ$eap[, 1]),
  theta_DASS  = as.numeric(walk_diag_DASS$eap[, 1]),
  theta_CDI   = as.numeric(walk_diag_CDI$eap[, 1])
)

diag_theta_long <- diag_theta %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("theta_"),
    names_to = "Measure",
    values_to = "Theta"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Measure = recode(
      Measure,
      theta_DSRSC = "DSRSC",
      theta_PHQ   = "PHQ-9",
      theta_CDI   = "CDI",
      theta_DASS  = "DASS"
    ),
    Depression_status = factor(
      Depression_status,
      levels = c("Non-depression", "Depression")
    )
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9.1) 原始总分 cutoff -> 协调后 theta cutoff
# ------------------------------------------------------------
diag_DSRSC_eapsum <- as.data.frame(walk_diag_DSRSC$eapsum)
diag_PHQ_eapsum   <- as.data.frame(walk_diag_PHQ$eapsum)
diag_DASS_eapsum  <- as.data.frame(walk_diag_DASS$eapsum)
diag_CDI_eapsum   <- as.data.frame(walk_diag_CDI$eapsum)

needed_cols <- c("Sum.Scores", "F1")
stopifnot(all(needed_cols %in% names(diag_DSRSC_eapsum)))
stopifnot(all(needed_cols %in% names(diag_PHQ_eapsum)))
stopifnot(all(needed_cols %in% names(diag_DASS_eapsum)))
stopifnot(all(needed_cols %in% names(diag_CDI_eapsum)))

cutoff_theta_DSRSC <- diag_DSRSC_eapsum$F1[diag_DSRSC_eapsum$Sum.Scores == cutoff_raw_DSRSC]
cutoff_theta_PHQ   <- diag_PHQ_eapsum$F1[diag_PHQ_eapsum$Sum.Scores == cutoff_raw_PHQ]
cutoff_theta_CDI   <- diag_CDI_eapsum$F1[diag_CDI_eapsum$Sum.Scores == cutoff_raw_CDI]
cutoff_theta_DASS_male   <- diag_DASS_eapsum$F1[diag_DASS_eapsum$Sum.Scores == cutoff_raw_DASS_male]
cutoff_theta_DASS_female <- diag_DASS_eapsum$F1[diag_DASS_eapsum$Sum.Scores == cutoff_raw_DASS_female]

stopifnot(
  length(cutoff_theta_DSRSC) == 1,
  length(cutoff_theta_PHQ) == 1,
  length(cutoff_theta_CDI) == 1,
  length(cutoff_theta_DASS_male) == 1,
  length(cutoff_theta_DASS_female) == 1
)

cat("\n协调后的 theta cutoff：\n")
cat("DSRSC:", round(cutoff_theta_DSRSC, 3), "\n")
cat("PHQ-9:", round(cutoff_theta_PHQ, 3), "\n")
cat("CDI:", round(cutoff_theta_CDI, 3), "\n")
cat("DASS male:", round(cutoff_theta_DASS_male, 3), "\n")
cat("DASS female:", round(cutoff_theta_DASS_female, 3), "\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10) 协调后分布图函数
#      —— theta cutoff 线
# ------------------------------------------------------------
plot_diag_theta_distribution <- function(data, measure_name, show_legend = FALSE) {

  dat <- data %>% filter(Measure == measure_name)
  n <- nrow(dat)

  p <- ggplot(
    dat,
    aes(x = Theta, fill = Depression_status, color = Depression_status)
  ) +
    geom_histogram(
      binwidth = 0.25,
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.25),
      alpha = 0.65,
      linewidth = 0.2
    ) +
    geom_density(
      aes(y = after_stat(density * n * 0.25)),
      linewidth = 1,
      alpha = 0.10,
      adjust = 1
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "Non-depression" = "#2ca25f",
        "Depression" = "#2b8cbe"
      )
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "Non-depression" = "#2ca25f",
        "Depression" = "#2b8cbe"
      )
    ) +
    labs(
      title = measure_name,
      x = "Depression latent score (θ)",
      y = "Frequency"
    ) +
    papaja::theme_apa(base_size = 18) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.position = if (show_legend) c(1.03, 0.98) else "none",
      legend.justification = c(1, 1),
      legend.direction = "vertical",
      legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3),
      legend.key = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.margin = margin(4, 6, 4, 6),
      plot.margin = margin(5.5, 12, 5.5, 5.5)
    )

  if (measure_name == "DSRSC") {
    p <- p + geom_vline(
      xintercept = cutoff_theta_DSRSC,
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.9,
      alpha = 0.8
    )
  }

  if (measure_name == "PHQ-9") {
    p <- p + geom_vline(
      xintercept = cutoff_theta_PHQ,
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.9,
      alpha = 0.8
    )
  }

  if (measure_name == "CDI") {
    p <- p + geom_vline(
      xintercept = cutoff_theta_CDI,
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.9,
      alpha = 0.8
    )
  }

  if (measure_name == "DASS") {
    p <- p +
      geom_vline(
        xintercept = cutoff_theta_DASS_male,
        linetype = "dashed",
        linewidth = 0.9,
        alpha = 0.8
      ) +
      geom_vline(
        xintercept = cutoff_theta_DASS_female,
        linetype = "dotted",
        linewidth = 0.9,
        alpha = 0.8
      )
  }

  return(p)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 11) 协调后分布图
# ------------------------------------------------------------
p_diag_theta_DSRSC <- plot_diag_theta_distribution(diag_theta_long, "DSRSC", TRUE)
p_diag_theta_PHQ   <- plot_diag_theta_distribution(diag_theta_long, "PHQ-9", FALSE)
p_diag_theta_CDI   <- plot_diag_theta_distribution(diag_theta_long, "CDI", FALSE)
p_diag_theta_DASS  <- plot_diag_theta_distribution(diag_theta_long, "DASS", FALSE)

diag_theta_plot <- (
  p_diag_theta_DSRSC |
  p_diag_theta_PHQ   |
  p_diag_theta_CDI   |
  p_diag_theta_DASS
) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Harmonized-score distributions by clinical diagnosis",
    tag_levels = "A",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 16),
      plot.tag = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")
    )
  )

ggsave(
  filename = here("FIGURE", "Diagnosis_Distribution_Harmonized.png"),
  plot = diag_theta_plot,
  width = 18,
  height = 5.2,
  dpi = 300
)

cat("✔ 已生成：FIGURE/Diagnosis_Distribution_Harmonized.png\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 12) 协调前后拼图
# ------------------------------------------------------------
diag_compare_plot <- diag_raw_plot / diag_theta_plot +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Distributions of scale scores before and after harmonization",
    tag_levels = "A",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 18),
      plot.tag = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")
    )
  )

ggsave(
  filename = here("FIGURE", "Diagnosis_Distribution_Raw_vs_Harmonized.png"),
  plot = diag_compare_plot,
  width = 18,
  height = 10.5,
  dpi = 300
)

cat("✔ 已生成：FIGURE/Diagnosis_Distribution_Raw_vs_Harmonized.png\n")
```
